title: end_to_end: runtime_ingress_dispatches_authenticated_gcp_slot_claim fails with CoapEncode
description: Pre-existing failure on main (e8fb59a387) AND on beads-worker-5 (8dc3c1aadd), independent of the worker-5 merge. lichen-gateway/tests/end_to_end.rs:1014: client.send_secure_request(POST /.well-known/lichen-gw/slots) returns Err(CoapEncode).
